2609.37891.title: It's All Training: A Fully Synthetic Single-Stage Recipe for LLMs
2609.37891.paper_summary: Current pre-training datasets are derived from web crawls, with all their issues, and were not designed to support mid- and post-training pipelines--for instance, they contain little explicit reasoning. Thus, many frontier labs have begun to develop their own internal datasets, starting from state-of-the-art models, to augment their pre-training data mix, eg, with reasoning traces to address cold-start problems. While demonstratively effective, none of these datasets are public, and the effect of this so-called synthetic data on knowledge and skill acquisition of language models, including small ones, remains poorly understood. We present SYNTH, the first open-source synthetic corpus derived from 58,698 Wikipedia articles that collapses pre-, mid-, and post-training into a single training stage via structured amplification of curated encyclopedic seeds. We evaluate SYNTH by training a suite of models: a 56M tiny model (Monad), 0.3B-0.6B dense models (Baguettotron), and a 13B / 1B-active MoE. At iso-compute, SYNTH outperforms filtered web data, and our models remain competitive with similarly-sized open-weight baselines. Because SYNTH is back-translated from grounded passages, SYNTH-trained models achieve high factual precision despite 10-140x fewer training tokens, with memorization targeted by the seed corpus. These results show that synthetic datasets, including our SYNTH dataset, are capable of producing competitive generalist models from a fraction of the training data, enabling rapid iteration as the frontier advances. These findings open up possibilities for both generalist models with significantly increased data efficiency, as well as domain-specific models where no instruction or conversational data is available. Finally, we publicly release our SYNTH dataset and the suite of Baguettotron models under a permissive license, thus supporting open-source language model development.
2609.37891.paper_summary_zh: 目前的預訓練數據集來源於網路爬蟲，存在各種問題，並未設計用於支持中期和後期訓練流程——例如，它們幾乎不包含明確的推理。因此，許多前沿實驗室已開始開發自己的內部數據集，從最先進的模型出發，以增強其預訓練數據組合，例如，通過推理痕跡來解決冷啟動問題。雖然這些數據集在演示上有效，但沒有一個是公開的，這種所謂的合成數據對語言模型（包括小型模型）的知識和技能獲取的影響仍然不甚了解。我們提出了SYNTH，這是第一個開源合成語料庫，來自58,698篇維基百科文章，通過結構化擴增策劃的百科種子，將預訓練、中期訓練和後期訓練合併為單一訓練階段。我們通過訓練一系列模型來評估SYNTH：一個56M的小型模型（Monad）、0.3B-0.6B的密集模型（Baguettotron）以及一個13B / 1B-活躍的MoE。在相同計算量下，SYNTH的表現超過了過濾後的網頁數據，我們的模型仍然與類似大小的開放權重基準保持競爭力。由於SYNTH是從有根據的段落反向翻譯而來，SYNTH訓練的模型在訓練標記數量少10-140倍的情況下仍能達到高事實精確度，記憶則由種子語料庫針對。這些結果顯示，合成數據集，包括我們的SYNTH數據集，能夠從少量的訓練數據中產生具有競爭力的通用模型，隨著前沿的推進實現快速迭代。這些發現為通用模型提供了顯著提高數據效率的可能性，以及在沒有指令或對話數據可用的情況下的領域特定模型。最後，我們在一個寬鬆的許可證下公開發布了我們的SYNTH數據集和Baguettotron模型系列，從而支持開源語言模型的開發。
